stem: Ishaan helps at a morning health camp. Three healthy classmates show body temperatures 36.8 °C, 37.0 °C, and 37.4 °C. A wall chart marks about 37.0 °C as a typical average and shows 41.5 °C as a very high fever reading.

options.text: All three can be healthy; 37.0 °C is a typical average, not an exact reading every healthy person must show.
A reading of 41.5 °C can also be normal for a healthy person.
Every healthy person's readings must average exactly 37.0 °C.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Healthy body temperature varies a little around about 37 °C, so 36.8 °C, 37.0 °C, and 37.4 °C can all be normal.

teacher.key_rationale: 37.0 °C is a useful average, not a single exact value every healthy person must match. Small differences around it are usual; 41.5 °C is not a normal healthy reading; requiring an exact personal average of 37.0 °C is wrong.
